authoredSuite.layout: two lines: n, then the bit string, LF terminated

notice: Recipe author report only; not an independent audit, signoff, qualification, or validated count.

officialReview.note: Official suite is incomplete (89 of 116) and its largest n is 93, so maximum-n coverage comes only from authored cases.

selectedSubmissions.note: Sources were read, not executed. Unit tests re-implement each listed faulty step as an own mutant and assert at least one authored case kills it. 14616287 is TLE-only (O(n^2) scan) and is not claimed as an algorithmic kill.

wrongAlgorithmsModeled.14918983: single run of three gets only +1
wrongAlgorithmsModeled.26640717: single double counted only at string ends
wrongAlgorithmsModeled.86885894: run>=3 or edge length-2 run only

semantics.checker: token comparison of one integer; no floating, multiple-answer, interactive, or file I/O
independentChecks: brute: every nonempty flip, LAS by enumerating all subsequences (n<=8) or 2-state DP (n<=12, random n<=40)
flip_dp: linear 3-phase (before/inside/after flip) subsequence DP, applied to every authored case including n=100000
semantics.oracle: answer = min(n, blocks + 2), blocks = 1 + number of adjacent unequal pairs
semantics.summary: n 1..100000 on line 1; binary string of exactly n characters on line 2. Flip exactly one nonempty contiguous substring, output the maximum longest alternating subsequence (single integer).

statement.comparison: Row description paragraphs, input_format and output_format occur verbatim in the public English statement text (tags stripped, U+2009 mapped to space). Constraint 1 ≤ n ≤ 100 000 is written out in both; no flattened superscripts.
statement.cosmeticMarkupLoss: Row note loses tex-font-style-bf/tt spans that mark which characters of '10000011' and '10011011' are bolded; examples are unaffected and the loss is not semantic.
